args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

round_money claimed to implement banker's rounding but actually used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round to the nearest even cent,
matching the FIN-212 spec and the tests.

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` claimed to implement banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, breaking the nightly build (`tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).
- Switched the quantization rounding to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`, `2.675 -> 2.68`).

## Testing
- Branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` CI run `ci-0001` passed.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Implement banker's rounding in round_money per FIN-212
